hints.newPassword: At least 12 characters. A long phrase you don’t use elsewhere works well.
hints.code: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
hints.totp: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

passwordProblems.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Too short: use at least 12 characters.
passwordProblems.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Too long: use at most 128 characters.
passwordProblems.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password appears in lists of leaked passwords. Please choose another one.
passwordProblems.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: This password is too repetitive. Please choose a more varied one.
passwordProblems.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_EMAIL: The password can’t contain the name from your email address.

demoOutboxNote: In this demo, emails aren’t sent: they are saved to the outbox folder of the project.

login.title: Sign in to IUA Connect
login.mfaIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.resendDone: If the account is waiting for verification, a new link has been sent.

register.title: Sign up for IUA Connect
register.intro: After signing up we’ll send you a link to verify your email address.
register.doneBody: If the address is valid, we’ve sent it a message with a link to continue.

verify.title: Verify your email address
verify.failedBody: The link may have been used already or have expired. You can ask for a new one:
verify.resendDone: If the account is waiting for verification, a new link has been sent.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.doneBody: If an account exists for this address, we’ve sent it a password reset link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.successBody: All previous sessions were signed out. You can sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This link is missing or incorrect. Please ask for a new one.

security.title: Account security
security.signInRequired: Please sign in to see this page.
security.enrollBanner: Your role requires two-step verification. Turn it on to get access to your administrative permissions.
security.mfaExplain: Each sign-in will also ask for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
security.setupScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app:
security.setupManual: Can’t scan it? Enter this key instead:
security.qrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
security.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you can’t use your authenticator app. They won’t be shown again.
security.disableRequiredByRole: Your role requires two-step verification, so it can’t be turned off.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
security.reauthIntro: Please confirm your identity before this change.
